steps.run: ({ newChatOpens: document.querySelector('main header').innerText.trim() === 'New chat' && document.querySelector('main').innerText.includes('What should we work on?') })

(() => { const field = document.querySelector("textarea[aria-label=Message]"); const style = getComputedStyle(field); return { messageHasKeyboardFocus: document.activeElement === field && field.matches(":focus-visible"), messageHasVisibleFocusRing: style.outlineStyle !== "none" && parseFloat(style.outlineWidth) >= 2 }; })()

(async () => { const shown = () => document.querySelector('main').innerText; for (let tries = 0; tries < 100 && !shown().includes('Check the project steps'); tries += 1) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); return { messageSent: shown().includes('Check the preview steps.'), replyRuns: !!document.querySelector('main button[aria-label=Stop]'), thinkingVisible: /Thinking|Thought/.test(shown()), toolStepRuns: shown().includes('Check the project steps') && !shown().includes('Preview reply complete.') }; })()

(async () => { const isShown = element => { if (!element) return false; element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'center' }); const box = element.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = document.elementFromPoint(box.left + box.width / 2, box.top + box.height / 2); return !!hit && element.contains(hit); }; const reason = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('main p')].find(element => element.textContent.includes('installation folders and operating system files')); const button = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('main button')].find(button => button.textContent.trim() === 'Allow for every chat of the Default profile'); for (let tries = 0; tries < 100 && !(isShown(reason()) && isShown(button())); tries += 1) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); return { startupReasonVisible: isShown(reason()), startupApprovalVisible: isShown(button()) }; })()

steps.clickOn: [...document.querySelectorAll('main button')].find(button => button.textContent.trim() === 'Allow for every chat of the Default profile')

steps.run: (async () => { const shown = () => document.querySelector('main').innerText; const table = () => document.querySelector('main table')?.innerText ?? ''; for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && !(table().includes('Complete') && !document.querySelector('main button[aria-label=Stop]')); tries += 1) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); return { replyComplete: shown().includes('Preview reply complete.') && shown().includes('The stand-in model thinks, runs a command, and replies.'), replyTableVisible: table().includes('Steps') && table().includes('Complete'), stepsFold: [...document.querySelectorAll('main button')].find(button => button.textContent.trim() === '1 step')?.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false', replyStopped: !document.querySelector('main button[aria-label=Stop]') }; })()

(() => { const isShown = button => !!button && !button.closest('[inert]') && button.checkVisibility() && button.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0; const buttons = [...document.querySelectorAll('main button')]; return { thoughtStepVisible: isShown(buttons.find(button => button.textContent.startsWith('Thought for'))), toolStepVisible: isShown(buttons.find(button => button.textContent.includes('Check the project steps'))) }; })()
